senses.gloss: to measure level distances. Y. Bicc. I, end, 64ᵇ מאן דמְקַדֵּר וכ׳, v. שִׁגְרוֹנַיָּיה.

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 8:10">Targ. Esth. VIII, 10</cite> <he>אִתְקַדְּרוּ פיסת וכ׳</he> (ed. Lag. <he>אתקדדו</he>) the soles of their feet were arched (so that they, in running, touched the ground only with their toes).
